title: raid start map: no cache or strongbox words
why: His order (2026-10-20): "map on this second preraid screen should not have caches labelled, makes the whole thing look messy". On the map that opens at raid start, the ten or so CACHE and LOOTED words and the STRONGBOX word, with their leader lines, are gone. The rings and icons stay so every spot is still marked. The m key map in the raid keeps its words.
now: The map at raid start shows cache and strongbox marks without the words.

edits.replacement:

    if(!mapFirstOn()) mapLabel(CQ.opened?'LOOTED':'CACHE',qx,qy-20*_MZ,UIC.tx_1,null,qy);
